messages:
ana: hi all, ana here in infra onboarding. i'm trying to provision a small GKE cluster in europe-west1 for a demo but `gcloud container clusters create` fails with 403 when creating KMS keys and attaching the VPC. error mentions org policy and encryptedDiskPermissions. anyone run into this during onboarding?

sam: welcome ana! :wave: quick Qs: which project id and which KMS key ring are you trying to use? org policies often require using a central keyring.

ana: project is redwood-sandbox-eu, i tried keyring projects/redwood-org/locations/europe-west1/keyRings/rdw-keyring. command fails at creating the CMEK key: Permission 'cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter' denied.

ravi: tagging @cloud-onboarding. we lock key creation to central infra-managed keyrings for all EU projects for compliance. we usually request a key via infra-requests and infra creates the key and grants the service account.

platform-bot: Note: Org constraint 'constraints/gcp.restrictCmekKeyCreation' is active. Run `gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-sandbox-eu` to view bindings.

ana: here's the IAM output snippet: `bindings: - members: - serviceAccount:project-org-admins@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter`

sam: yep that indicates only org admin SA has kms encrypter role. best path: file infra-requests (type: KMS key provisioning) with project id, intended use, and VPC name. ask for grant to the node pool SA and the workload SA. mention this is for a short demo if you need faster turnaround.

ana: filing now. IR-9981 created. marked urgency: medium, notes: demo cluster europe-west1, 1 control plane, 2 n1-standard-4 nodes, need CMEK for disk encryption and VPC attachment.

platform-bot: Infra request IR-9981 received and triaged. Assigned to infra-ops. ETA ~1 business day.

ravi: if you need it sooner we can approve a temporary service account grant for 48 hours, but that requires a manager signoff. do you need it today?

ana: it's for a customer demo tomorrow morning, so sooner would help. i'll ask my manager for signoff and paste it here.

sam: once infra creates the key they will add the proper bindings and we can proceed. also double-check org policy for allowed VPC peering; some EU projects require explicit peering approval.

ana: manager signoff posted. can we do the temporary SA flow?

ravi: okay i'll coordinate with infra-ops. ana, i'll DM you creds for the temporary SA and the minimal steps to run the cluster create.

ana: received creds and managed to create the cluster with CMEK after infra applied bindings. demo green. thanks everyone! :tada:
